name: thai-book-production
description: End-to-end technical/tutorial book production pipeline for Claude Cowork — reference gathering, outline (with human approval gate), chapter writing with AI figures (built-in TextToImage / Gemini nano-banana) and mockup screenshots, content/language QC, Markdown-authored slides compiled to YAML, standalone PPTX/slide-image rendering, per-slide TTS (built-in TextToSpeech / Gemini), deterministic chapter video assembly (ffmpeg), glossary/index, translation, AI cover design, and epub/PDF build. Thai-first, keeps technical terms in English.
